te: “Where are our delegations?” ex-Ambassador of Ukraine criticized the work in the United States
de: Eight candidates refused to take the post of Ukraine’s ambassador to the United States, which has been vacant for several months. This was stated by the former head of the Ukrainian diplomatic mission in Washington Valery Chaly, whose words are cited by the publication “Left Bank”.

t: В Кении осуждённого на 200 лет лидера секты признали виновным ещё в 123 смертях
d: В Кении суд признал лидера религиозной секты Пола Маккензи виновным в гибели ещё 123 последователей. Ранее проповедник получил 200 лет тюрьмы за убийство 191 человека, включая 190 детей. Об этом сообщает Sky News.
te: Kenyan sect leader convicted of 200 years in 123 deaths
de: In Kenya, a court found Paul Mackenzie, the leader of a religious sect, guilty of the deaths of 123 followers. He was sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murder of 191 people, including 190 children. It's reported by Sky News.

t: Умер бывший посол России в Нигерии Алексей Шебаршин
d: Бывший посол России в Нигерии Алексей Шебаршин скоропостижно скончался на 68-м году жизни. О смерти дипломата сообщили в Министерстве иностранных дел России.
te: Former Russian Ambassador to Nigeria Alexey Shebarshin Dies
de: Former Russian Ambassador to Nigeria Alexei Shebarshin has died suddenly at the 68th year of life. The death of the diplomat was reported in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia.

d: Продажи Grand Theft Auto VI за первую неделю после релиза достигли 53 млн копий, а их денежный объём составил около $4,7 млрд. Такие оценки представил аналитик компании Alinea Analytics Рис Эллиотт.
te: Analysts estimate sales of GTA VI for the first week at 53 million copies
de: Sales of Grand Theft Auto VI in the first week after the release reached 53 million copies, and their cash volume amounted to about $ 4.7 billion, such estimates were presented by an analyst at Alinea Analytics Rhys Elliott.

de: Russian pianist and conductor Konstantin Lifshitz has died after a long struggle with melanoma. The musician died on November 26 at the 50th year of his life. About the cause of his death TASS reported a source from the environment of the artist.

te: Rosstat: Gasoline in Russia in October fell by 3.9%
de: Automotive gasoline in Russia in October fell by an average of 3.9% compared to September. This is evidenced by the data of Rosstat, which leads “Mail Finance”.

t: Суд в Челябинске изъял в пользу государства активы семи дорожных компаний

te: The court in Chelyabinsk seized in favor of the state assets of seven road companies
de: The Soviet district court of Chelyabinsk has satisfied the anti-corruption claim of the Prosecutor General’s Office for the seizure of assets of seven road companies in favor of the state. The decision was made on November 27 and is subject to immediate execution, the press service of the court said.

te: In Moscow, traffic on Komsomolsky Prospekt was restored after a mass accident
de: Traffic along Komsomolsky Prospekt in Moscow has been fully restored after a mass accident with five victims. This was reported by the Metropolitan Department of transport in the messenger MAX.

de: In Moscow from January 2, 2027 will adjust the cost of travel in public transport. On the revision of tariffs, the capital Department of transport reported.

de: The Polish military does not always intercept missiles considered Russian because of the risk to civilians. This was stated at a meeting with Ukrainian journalists in Warsaw by Minister of Justice and Prosecutor General of Poland Waldemar Jourek.

te: The cost of evacuation of cars in Moscow will be indexed from January 1
de: From January 1, 2027, Moscow will index tariffs for the evacuation of cars and their storage at specialized parking lots. About it RIA “Novosti” reported in the press service of the capital Department of transport.

de: In Ukraine, the camps for prisoners of war after the abolition of martial law will continue to work as institutions for the execution of sentences. This decision is enshrined in the decree of the Cabinet of Ministers No. 1474 of November 25, 2026.

te: The Ministry of industry and trade explained what will go the money from the technical fee for smartphones and laptops
de: Funds from the technological collection for electronics in Russia will be directed to the development and production of domestic equipment. This was told in the Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Russian Federation.

t: Пенсионерка из ФРГ устроила засаду курьеру мошенников, три часа изображая жертву
d: В немецкой Баварии 65-летняя пенсионерка помогла полиции задержать курьера телефонных мошенников. Женщина почти три часа поддерживала разговор с аферистами, пока правоохранители готовили засаду, пишет газета Münchner Merkur.
te: A pensioner from Germany ambushed a courier of fraudsters, three hours portraying the victim
de: In Bavaria, Germany, a 65-year-old pensioner helped police detain a courier of phone scammers. The woman spent almost three hours talking to scammers while law enforcement officers were preparing an ambush, the Münchner Merkur newspaper writes.

te: Residents of Dnepropetrovsk blocked the road due to prolonged lack of light
de: Residents of Dnepropetrovsk came out to protest because of the multi-day power outages. About the consequences of the shutdowns told the Ukrainian edition “Public”.

de: US President Donald Trump is trying to maintain friendly relations with Russian leader Vladimir Putin for the sake of resolving the conflict in Ukraine. The head of the White House said this in an interview with journalists.

de: In Russia, launched a program of professional retraining of State Duma deputies from among veterans of the SVO. The training started on November 27 in the management workshop “Senezh”. This program is being implemented on behalf of President Vladimir Putin.

d: Страны Балтии должны превратиться в «военного дикобраза», чтобы сдержать возможное нападение России. С таким предложением выступил бывший начальник Штаба обороны Великобритании генерал Николас Картер в статье для The Telegraph.
